providers.title: Vanishing of higher bounded Hochschild cohomology
providers.scope: For every von Neumann algebra M and k >= 2, every bounded cocycle in C_b^k(M,M) is the coboundary of a bounded cochain. The proof is completed in the fifth lesson and uses two classical theorems, K1 and K2.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Ultrapower extensions
providers.scope: A bounded map of a tracial von Neumann algebra that is continuous on operator-norm balls for the 2-norm has a uniform modulus and extends to every tracial ultrapower with the same norm bound and the same continuity.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Normal maps are continuous on balls
providers.scope: A bounded normal map of a von Neumann algebra with faithful normal tracial state is continuous on operator-norm balls for the 2-norm; Exercise 4.5 proves the converse.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Rigidity of first-letter identities
providers.scope: If a bounded map, continuous on balls for the 2-norm, multiplies every word with pairwise distinct indices in a free Haar family on the left by a or by b according to the sign of its first letter, then a = b.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Powers of one unitary
providers.scope: A bounded linear map with S(V^k) = aV^k and S(V^-k) = bV^-k for all k >= 1, for a unitary V of a finite von Neumann algebra with faithful normal tracial state, has a = b.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Distinguished letters
providers.scope: For Haar unitaries free from a coefficient algebra and from each other, a word in path expressions, each containing a letter that occurs nowhere else in the list, has trace zero.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Finitely many trace conditions
providers.scope: In an algebra of type II1 with separable predual, finitely many such trace conditions can be met approximately by unitaries: in a factor through Popa's free independence theorem, in general fibre by fibre in the central decomposition.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: An asymptotically free random walk
providers.scope: A symmetric probability measure on the unitary group with countably many atoms, including a 2-norm dense sequence, whose independent long products have asymptotically the joint moments of free Haar unitaries.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The Liouville theorem
providers.scope: A bounded linear map that is harmonic for the walk and continuous on balls for the 2-norm is left multiplication by its value at 1.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Primitives in the separable tracial case
providers.scope: A separately normal cocycle of degree k >= 2 on an algebra of type II1 with separable predual and faithful normal tracial state has a primitive of norm at most its own.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Type II1 from matrix units
providers.scope: A von Neumann algebra with separable predual and faithful normal tracial state that contains unital matrix units of every size is of type II1.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Primitives in the tracial case
providers.scope: The same bound for every algebra of type II1 with a faithful normal tracial state, through conditional expectations onto countably generated subalgebras and pointwise ultraweak compactness.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A central homotopy
providers.scope: For a central projection z, an explicit operator J_z on cochains with values in zM satisfies dJ_z + J_z d = id - cut_z and has norm at most n - 1 in degree n.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Tracial pieces
providers.scope: Every von Neumann algebra of type II1 is the sum of central summands of type II1 that have faithful normal tracial states; with the central homotopy and the classical K1 and K2 this gives Theorem 1.2 of the first lesson for every von Neumann algebra.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
